summary.corpus_hash_byte_form: sha256 over, for each audited file sorted by repo-relative POSIX path: path-bytes + NUL + the file's raw on-disk bytes + NUL. Reproducible only from an equivalent checkout — line endings are part of the hashed bytes. Covers the AUDITED SKILL CORPUS ONLY (each skill's SKILL.md + references + eval JSONs). It does NOT cover the AUXILIARY inputs that also affect output — docs/skills-catalog.md (content → manifest `family`), the `.claude/agents/` filenames (→ known_names + manifest), and the `docs/paths/` filenames (→ manifest); those are summarized separately under `auxiliary_inputs`. The engine that produced the scan is identified separately by engine_sha256.

skills_catalog.kind: auxiliary content (feeds manifest `family`); not in corpus hash

agent_names_enumerated.kind: enumerated name only (feeds known_names + manifest); not in corpus hash

guided_path_names_enumerated.kind: enumerated name only (feeds manifest); not in corpus hash

rule_inventory.purpose: read-only-declared skill instructs artifact writes
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §5 (default read-only); human-approval-boundary
rule_inventory.limits: verb-anchored and lexical; misses unanchored phrasing

rule_inventory.purpose: read-only-declared skill mentions scratch/temp/memory writes
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §5 (the exception excludes external/live-state mutation)
rule_inventory.limits: proximity windows can join unrelated clauses; negation excluded, reported-speech is not

rule_inventory.purpose: read-only-declared skill grants write-capable tools
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §5/§2 (a read-and-report skill needs no allowed-tools widening)
rule_inventory.limits: none known: declaration and grant are both objective frontmatter facts

rule_inventory.purpose: auto-invocable skill's Workflow instructs a §5 mutation class without cover
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §5 (write/network/deploy/spend needs disable-model-invocation:true; §5 recognizes two bounded exceptions — the previewed doc/state approved-write, and a separately classified and separately activated TALI route that no shipped skill holds by default). This scanner recognizes only the doc/state approved-write; TALI activation is out of band, so these candidates remain unresolved and unchanged by TALI adoption
rule_inventory.limits: covers the §5 classes (source/test/config writes, VCS mutation, install, network, deploy/provision, data-store/live-state writes, spend, unbound doc/state writes) as lexical verb+noun patterns, at most ONE candidate per class per skill; fenced snippets INCLUDED by design (a fenced push is still an instruction); instruction-vs-teaching is the reviewer's call, hence semantic-candidate; the approved-write exception applies ONLY to the doc-state-write class and ONLY when exact-path + content-preview + approval markers sit within a few lines of the write — approval language elsewhere never suppresses anything (extra negative fixture: approved-doc-writer)

rule_inventory.purpose: bare generic status value with no approval class
rule_inventory.authority: scoped-approval-register (Status / Scope allowed / FORBIDDEN / Evidence pattern)
rule_inventory.limits: line-anchored; a qualified status split across lines is missed

rule_inventory.purpose: scope grant authorizing BUILD from a requirements-stage approval
rule_inventory.authority: human-approval-boundary; scoped-approval-register (deny-by-default)
rule_inventory.limits: the phrase can appear in text that CRITIQUES the grant — use vs mention is a reading

rule_inventory.purpose: approval record with allowed scope but no forbidden scope
rule_inventory.authority: scoped-approval-register (Scope allowed / FORBIDDEN both required)
rule_inventory.limits: file-level absence check: one of several records lacking the field reports once

rule_inventory.purpose: append-only-declared file carries mutable placeholders
rule_inventory.authority: project-state-template.md (rules 1-2: append-only; supersede, never rewrite)
rule_inventory.limits: a placeholder shown as an illustration of what NOT to write fires too (use vs mention)

rule_inventory.purpose: append-only-declared file instructs overwrite/rewrite/truncate
rule_inventory.authority: project-state-template.md (rule 2: never edit or delete a past entry); AEGIS handoff §C
rule_inventory.limits: ±15-line proximity trades recall for precision; Gotchas/Stop Conditions masked

rule_inventory.purpose: middle insertion described inside an append-only contract
rule_inventory.authority: AEGIS handoff §C (append-only: new bytes begin at EOF)
rule_inventory.limits: "insert" describing a UI action rather than a file mutation can fire within the window

rule_inventory.purpose: exact-operation claim with unbound placeholders in command fences
rule_inventory.authority: AEGIS handoff §C / AEGIS-058 (authorization binds exact target/payload; no placeholders)
rule_inventory.limits: a template teaching placeholder-then-bind legitimately shows placeholders — a reading

rule_inventory.purpose: narrative approved-state section inside an append-only contract
rule_inventory.authority: project-state-template.md (rule 1: two dated entry types; latest snapshot wins)
rule_inventory.limits: whether a (approved) section has workable supersession semantics is a design question

rule_inventory.authority: AEGIS handoff §D durability taxonomy (that no repo standard names it IS AEGIS-056)
rule_inventory.limits: any "committed" in the file suppresses it (under-fires); figurative "durable" over-fires

rule_inventory.purpose: routing reference to a name that is not on disk
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §2 (descriptions route by exact names); validator D55
rule_inventory.limits: curated non-skill allowlist; reviewer agents count as known; unbackticked stale names missed

rule_inventory.purpose: exclusion toward a neighbor that never reciprocates (CENSUS)
rule_inventory.authority: skill-quality-reviewer (collision failure mode); reciprocity is NOT a written standard — census evidence
rule_inventory.limits: many one-directional exclusions are correct (hub skills cannot name every excluder); CENSUS data, maps to NO AEGIS id

rule_inventory.purpose: a Stage-2 route reaches the commitments skill without a readiness/NOT-COMMIT-ABLE guard ON THAT ROUTE, or the roadmap owner is not independently classified
rule_inventory.authority: project-orchestrator (Stage-2 per-owner routes); roadmap-to-commitments-translator (readiness mode returns NOT COMMIT-ABLE when evidence is absent)
rule_inventory.limits: PER-ROUTE (v1.11.0): validates EACH physical line naming roadmap-to-commitments-translator together with a routing marker — reusing the SHARED ROUTING_LINE grammar (arrow / invoke / route-to / hand off/over/to / delegate to / goes to / belongs to / owned by), so no active commitments route is missed. The readiness / NOT COMMIT-ABLE guard must be ON THAT LINE and POSITIVE — EVERY guard phrase (NOT COMMIT-ABLE included) gets a negation check BOTH before and after the phrase, so 'not readiness mode', 'without a NOT COMMIT-ABLE guard', 'readiness mode not required', and 'readiness mode skipped' do not clear it. The roadmap owner (roadmap-under-uncertainty-planner) must carry a recorded VERDICT PHRASE — a classification act with its result ('classified n/a', 'classify <owner> applicable', 'recorded as n/a', 'n/a-recorded') — on a NON-invocation line: a routing marker, the bare word 'owner', a QUESTION, an uncertain MODAL ('may be n/a'), a PENDING state ('unclassified'), and a bare-token CRITERIA/definition bullet ('APPLICABLE on evidence of …') all do NOT count; classified n/a is valid. A zero honestly means every commitments-reaching route is self-guarded AND the roadmap owner carries a recorded verdict. Bound to the literal **Stage 2/**Stage 3 markers and to single-physical-line routes

rule_inventory.purpose: committed used as a roadmap horizon label
rule_inventory.authority: roadmap-to-commitments-translator (reserves 'committed' for capacity-backed promises); AEGIS §F
rule_inventory.limits: lexical: fires wherever the label pattern appears, including text QUOTING the conflict to warn about it

rule_inventory.purpose: approved scope described as a commitment
rule_inventory.authority: roadmap-to-commitments-translator (commit-able vs aspirational); AEGIS §F
rule_inventory.limits: lexical: cannot tell asserting the laundering from warning against it; low base rate keeps it usable

rule_inventory.purpose: Validation Checklist with no checkable items
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §4 item 6 (a checklist the model runs before done)
rule_inventory.limits: only the "- [ ]" form counts; a substantive prose checklist fails

rule_inventory.purpose: Output Format too thin to verify against
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §4 item 5 (the exact shape of the deliverable)
rule_inventory.limits: length thresholds are proxies; a long vague contract passes, a short precise one fails

rule_inventory.purpose: no negative discrimination case anywhere in the skill's evals (STRUCTURAL)
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §6 (at least a should-not-do case)
rule_inventory.limits: STRUCTURAL PRESENCE ONLY — a present negative case may still be hollow; behavioral proof is UNRUN

rule_inventory.purpose: eval case unjudgeable as written (per schema)
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §6 (objective assertions); repo eval schemas
rule_inventory.limits: field presence is not assertion quality; both schemas are repo conventions

rule_inventory.purpose: approval/state-related skill with no refusal or boundary case
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §6; skill-quality-reviewer (real boundaries vs hollow filler)
rule_inventory.limits: risk classification is keyword-based; a refusal keyword in an unrelated assertion satisfies it spuriously

rule_inventory.purpose: trigger-eval neighbor name not machine-resolvable
rule_inventory.authority: repo trigger-evals convention; eval-runner-designer (a runner must resolve names)
rule_inventory.limits: only the (subagent)/(agent) annotation is stripped; the AEGIS-060 CANDIDATE it evidences is recorded in the register, not asserted as an established mapping here

rule_inventory.purpose: markdown link target missing on disk
rule_inventory.authority: validator D55 link-check precedent; skill-generation-standard.md §3/§9
rule_inventory.limits: fenced example links excluded; targets with spaces/angle-brackets not parsed

rule_inventory.purpose: absolute user-machine path in shipped content
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §5 (never embed absolute machine-specific paths)
rule_inventory.limits: fictional example paths in teaching text fire; macOS /Users/ is not distinguishable from an example

rule_inventory.purpose: bare references/ file mention missing on disk
rule_inventory.authority: skill-generation-standard.md §4 item 9 / §3 (Supporting Files)
rule_inventory.limits: only the literal references/…md form is checked
